name: Pass 24 certificate bundle hardening
goal: Ensure quality certificates validate against actual referenced panel score and refinery gate evidence files.
risks: A pass certificate could be validated without bundled evidence
A certificate could reference a panel ID that does not match the panel file
A certificate could reference a refinery gate ID that does not match the gate file

nodes.label: Pass 24 certificate bundle critic review

node_contract.why: Stage certificates must be tied to actual panel and gate evidence, not merely matching strings.
node_contract.how: Inspect validator behavior, reproduce bypasses, and define bundle-mode checks.
node_contract.who: Codex using quality, governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every finding is covered by executable positive and negative checks.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any new certificate bypass becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner negative fixture.

nodes.label: Certificate bundle validator implementation

node_contract.what: Extend quality certificate validation to compare referenced evidence files.
node_contract.why: Acceptance certificates must bind to actual expert-panel and refinery-gate evidence.
node_contract.how: Add bundle-mode arguments, compare panel/gate IDs and contents, require bundle mode for pass certificates, and sync workspace files.
node_contract.where: df-quality-refinery installed skill and workspace bundle.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before evidence closure.
node_contract.how_good: Bundled certificate passes while unbundled, panel-mismatch, and gate-mismatch certificates fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every validator change.
gates: positive and negative bundle fixtures behave as expected

nodes.label: Pass 24 verification sweep

node_contract.why: The bundle hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 24 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
